title: VibeDeck rule topic
description: Behaviors a topic must have; agents verify them before calling a task done. Lives at <repo>/.vibedeck/rules/<slug>.json.

paths.description: Globs relative to the project root (*, ?, **). Empty or absent: the topic applies to every task.

sourceIdea.description: Idea this topic was promoted from.

text.description: The expected behavior, short and verifiable.

severity.description: must blocks completion; should only warns.

test.description: How the rule is verified. script: `command` runs at the project root with $VIBEDECK_FILES (exit 0 = pass, 77 = n/a, else fail) and decides the rule in checks; manual: the agent answers it. Stale when ruleHash differs from the rule's current text+details hash.

reason.description: What the script checks, or why the rule is manual.

ruleHash.description: First 16 hex chars of SHA-256(text + "\n" + details) when the test was written.
